english: Catch-up from your most recent sent message | S{number} {target}
Catch-up from your most recent sent message | {target}
The log follows the selected server and conversation. A channel or query receives composed messages.
Slash opens command entry. An ordinary character starts composition. ? opens help for the selected conversation.
Use /servers, /channels, /queries, /unread, or /summary to inspect client activity.
Escape backgrounds from the log. Inside composition or a reader, Escape first returns to the previous screen.
